result.instructions: Tools for Workyard, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are clocked in right now?"; "Show all submitted time cards from last week that are not approved yet."; "List my active projects and the geofences they use.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Workyard data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workyard_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workyard_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workyard_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. workyard_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workyard_get_organization
tools.title: Get Workyard organization
tools.description: The organization this connection uses (id, name, settings such as timezone) from GET /orgs/{org_id}.

tools.name: workyard_list_employees
tools.title: List Workyard employees
tools.description: List employees of the organization (employee_id, profile_id, name, title, role, status, contact data). Filter by status (active, removed, saas_disabled, expired; comma list), email, role name or free-text search. Paged: use next_page.

status.description: Employee status filter: active, removed, saas_disabled, expired (comma list; sent as eq:...).

search.description: Free-text search over name, email and identifier.

email.description: Exact email filter (comma list allowed; sent as eq:...).

role_name.description: Role filter: worker, manager, admin (comma list; sent as eq:...).

employee_id.description: One or more employee ids, comma separated.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: workyard_list_projects
tools.title: List Workyard projects
tools.description: List projects (id, name, identifier, customer, locations). Optionally filter by name or archived state. Paged: use next_page.

name.description: Project name: a plain name matches names starting with it (like:name%); eq:... and like:... forms are passed through.

is_archived.description: true = archived projects only, false = active only (default: Workyard's default).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: workyard_get_project
tools.title: Get Workyard project
tools.description: One project by id (workyard_list_projects gives the ids).

tools.name: workyard_list_time_cards
tools.title: List Workyard time cards
tools.description: List time cards (id, employee_id, start_dt_unix, end_dt_unix, status, approver, totals). Workyard returns only status=working when no status is given, so pass status (for example submitted,approved) for finished work. Filter by employee and by start time (unix seconds, interpreted in the organization timezone). Paged: use next_page; the reply also carries time_summary.

status.description: Status filter such as working, submitted, approved or submitted,approved (sent as eq:...). Omitted = working only.

employee_id.description: One or more employee ids, comma separated.

start_from_unix.description: Time card started at or after this unix time (seconds).

start_before_unix.description: Time card started before this unix time (seconds).

include_last_location.description: Include the employee's last known location (personal data).

sort_by.description: Sort in Workyard syntax: asc: or desc: plus start_dt or updated_at, joined with +, e.g. desc:start_dt.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: workyard_get_time_card
tools.title: Get Workyard time card
tools.description: One time card by id, with its details (workyard_list_time_cards gives the ids).

tools.name: workyard_list_time_card_activity_segments
tools.title: List Workyard time card activity segments
tools.description: The activity segments of one time card (where and on which project the employee worked, segment by segment). Not paged.

annotations.title: List Workyard time card activity segments

tools.name: workyard_list_geofences
tools.title: List Workyard geofences (work sites)
tools.description: List geofences / work sites (id, name, place, enabled, radius). Filter by name, enabled state or project. Paged: use next_page.

name.description: Geofence name: a plain name matches names starting with it; eq:... and like:... forms are passed through.

project_id.description: Only geofences of this project id (comma list allowed).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: workyard_list_active_geofences
tools.title: List active Workyard geofences
tools.description: All active geofences with limited data (Workyard: GET active_geofences). It does not say who is clocked in; use workyard_list_time_cards with status working for that.

tools.name: workyard_list_geofence_projects
tools.title: List projects of a Workyard geofence
tools.description: The projects attached to one geofence (work site). Paged: use next_page.

geofence_id.description: The geofence id (workyard_list_geofences gives the ids).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

annotations.title: List projects of a Workyard geofence

tools.name: workyard_approve_time_card
tools.title: Approve a Workyard time card
tools.description: WRITE: approve ONE time card (PATCH .../time_cards/{id}/approve). Approval feeds payroll in Workyard and may not be undoable through the API: only call it when the user asked to approve this exact time card.

time_card_id.description: The time card id to approve.

tools.name: workyard_add_time_card_note
tools.title: Add a note to a Workyard time card
tools.description: WRITE: add a text note to one time card (POST .../time_cards/{id}/notes). Adds a new note on every call; it does not edit or delete existing notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a Workyard time card

prompts.title: Get started with Workyard
prompts.description: What you can do with Workyard here, with example requests to try.
